data.name: Radhansh
data.long_meaning: The name Radhansh is derived from Sanskrit and Hindu culture. It is a combination of two words - Radha and Ansh. Radha means wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Ansh means presence or form. Together, Radhansh means the Lord of Wealth or the One who brings prosperity and abundance in life.
